retired_requirements.reason: Compresses independently assessable Article 10(1)-(4) propositions into one article-level abstraction.
Compresses independently assessable Article 13(1)-(3) propositions into one article-level abstraction.

migration_notes: Article 10(6) is represented as an applicability qualification on Article 10(2)-(4) records rather than as a synthetic standalone duty.
Article 10(1)'s 2026 cross-reference to Article 4a(1) is preserved; Article 4a remains a separate re-extraction target.
Source-defined compounds remain one source unit only where the source intentionally groups constituent criteria; those constituents are enumerated explicitly.
Candidate records must be expanded with registered source metadata and provenance by the migration script before canonical insertion.

requirements.requirement_summary: Where a high-risk AI system uses techniques involving training AI models with data, develop it on training, validation and testing data sets that satisfy the applicable quality criteria in Article 10(2)-(4) and the cross-referenced conditions in Article 4a(1).
applicable_actor: Provider of a high-risk AI system
governed_object: Training, validation and testing data sets used for a high-risk AI system
requirements.governance_expectation: Where a high-risk AI system uses techniques involving training AI models with data, develop it on training, validation and testing data sets that satisfy the applicable quality criteria in Article 10(2)-(4) and the cross-referenced conditions in Article 4a(1).
applicability_conditions: Applies when techniques involving training AI models with data are used and the relevant data sets are used.
exceptions_or_qualifications: Article 10(1) expressly cross-refers to Article 4a(1) in the 27 July 2026 consolidated text.
